Write a Python function named compute_properties with an optional file_path argument that defaults to ".".
The function defines file_path as the base directory containing the local input files.
The function loads stable_entries_Mg_Ga_N.json from file_path and constructs ComputedEntry objects using ComputedEntry.from_dict.
The function builds a PhaseDiagram from the stable entries and a ChemicalPotentialDiagram to obtain chemical_potential_limits.
The function reads bulk_sc/vasprun.xml.gz using Vasprun and obtains the bulk entry, final structure, VBM, CBM, and band gap.
The VBM is the top of the valence band from eigenvalue_band_properties.
The CBM is the bottom of the conduction band from eigenvalue_band_properties.
The band_gap is calculated as CBM minus VBM.
The bulk_structure is taken from bulk_vasprun.final_structure.
The function finds all gallium site indices in the bulk structure by checking site.specie.symbol == "Ga".
The Mg_Ga defect is created as a Substitution defect using the first gallium site index.
The function loops over sorted subdirectories in the Mg_Ga directory.
For each charge-state subfolder, the function creates a DefectEntry using DefectEntry.from_computational_data with the Mg_Ga defect, the subfolder vasprun.xml.gz, the subfolder LOCPOT.gz, the bulk_sc LOCPOT.gz, and dielectric equal to 14.
The function builds a FormationEnergyDiagram using the defect_entries, chemical_potential_limits, vbm, cbm, and band_gap.
The function sets chemical_potential_limits_count to the length of formation_energy_diagram.chemical_potential_limits.
The function returns a dictionary with key "chemical_potential_limits_count" and an integer value.
The function includes all necessary imports and a complete docstring describing the input parameter, data types, and output dictionary.
